choice.meaning: After examining the complete supplied window, neither of those operative disclosure structures is present; descriptive, definitional, indemnity, or information-content references do not count.
choice.name: no_disclosure_norm

grounded_in_existing_acquired_meanings.question: Inspect the complete supplied WINDOW. Does it contain operative authorization to disclose the protected information to personnel or service-provider classes, an operative prohibition on disclosure to third parties or outsiders, both structures, or neither? Include governing language, inherited list items, and applicable restriction units in the evidence.

choice.meaning: After examining the complete supplied window, no operative return-or-destroy duty for the protected information is present.
choice.name: no_disposal_duty

grounded_in_existing_acquired_meanings.question: Inspect the complete supplied WINDOW for every operative duty to return or destroy protected information. Which trigger categories occur: only contractual endpoints, only supplier requests, both endpoint and request triggers, or no such duty? A business-relationship deadline or termination is an endpoint but is not purpose completion.

choice.meaning: After examining the complete supplied window, no express post-disposal retention permission or prohibition is stated.
choice.name: no_retention_rule

grounded_in_existing_acquired_meanings.question: Inspect the complete supplied WINDOW. After or as part of returning or destroying protected information, does the source expressly permit limited retention, expressly forbid retention, contain both, or state neither? General copying rules count only when the source connects them to the disposal process.
